description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller 'MerchantStoreController' responsible for managing merchant store operations in the admin section of the web application. It includes request mappings for listing, creating, editing, saving, validating, and deleting merchant stores, along with supporting methods for setting up page models and handling email notifications.

classes.name: MerchantStoreController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing merchant stores in the admin panel, including listing, creating, editing, saving, validating, and deleting store entities.

methods.name: displayStores
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of merchant stores, setting up the menu and returning the view for store list.

methods.name: pageStores
methods.description: Handles POST requests for paginated store data, returning JSON with store information for display in an AJAX data grid.

methods.name: displayMerchantStoreCreate
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new merchant store, initializing store data and setup.

methods.name: displayMerchantStore
methods.description: Displays the store creation/editing page with data pre-populated based on store object.

methods.name: saveMerchantStore
methods.description: Processes POST submission for saving or updating a merchant store, including validation, association resolution, email notification on store creation, and session update.

methods.name: checkStoreCode
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to verify if a store code already exists, returning JSON status.

methods.name: removeMerchantStore
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to delete an existing merchant store, with permission checks for superadmin.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set up menu context attributes for view rendering.
